limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.

The offline reading check loads the retained copy from disk in an offline browser context while the lab instance keeps running for the other checks. It proves independence from the network and from the app's reader, not a stopped-instance drill.
No support report was submitted. The external tracker was deliberately blocked and only the local behavior was observed.
The Distribution commit shown carries the working-changes marker because the reader serves the working documentation bytes; that marker is the intended development-preview behavior.
